source_scope_note: The accessible source text describes the article's diagnostic scope and approach but did not expose the complete 50-code table in the page text available to this importer. This reference therefore stores only source-supported information and does not invent missing code rows.

documents.title: Freightliner common DTC diagnostic guide - FridayParts
documents.summary: FridayParts describes Freightliner DTCs as diagnostic tools for heavy-duty trucks and equipment powered by Detroit Diesel engines. The guide uses SPN and FMI structure to identify faults across fuel, air, electrical, transmission and safety systems, and pairs commonly encountered codes with symptoms, causes and practical repair steps.

documents.title: Freightliner DTC troubleshooting workflow - FridayParts
documents.summary: The source recommends a structured troubleshooting approach rather than guesswork. It highlights low fuel rail pressure, coolant-temperature warnings, CAN communication errors and ABS faults as examples of diagnostic areas and emphasizes prioritizing repairs by severity to reduce downtime and prevent larger failures.

documents.title: Use SPN and FMI together when interpreting Freightliner faults
documents.summary: Panta should interpret a Freightliner diagnostic report using the complete SPN/FMI combination and available module/engine context. The FridayParts guide specifically frames understanding SPN and FMI structure as the basis for pinpointing system faults. Cross-check exact code meaning against Panta's Detroit OEM/controller-specific references when available.

documents.title: Low fuel rail pressure diagnostic category
documents.summary: FridayParts identifies low fuel rail pressure as a common diagnostic area in its Freightliner DTC guide. A separate FridayParts guide specifically identifies SPN 157 FMI 18 as low fuel rail pressure and recommends diagnosing the root fuel-supply problem before replacing expensive components. Use Detroit OEM data in Panta for controller-specific interpretation and thresholds.

documents.title: CAN communication and ABS diagnostic category
documents.summary: The FridayParts Freightliner guide explicitly includes CAN communication errors and ABS-system faults among its common diagnostic areas. Panta should treat these as system/network diagnoses: identify the reporting module and exact SPN/FMI, inspect power, grounds, wiring/connectors and network communication before assuming a module itself has failed.

documents.title: FridayParts guide is supplemental to OEM Detroit/Freightliner data
documents.summary: Use this FridayParts article as practical supplemental troubleshooting context. When its general advice and Panta's Detroit OEM/controller-specific fault references overlap, prioritize the exact OEM SPN/FMI/controller/generation definition and use the FridayParts material as secondary workflow guidance.
